plugins.name: glasser-seo-audit
plugins.description: SEO audit of any website on real data from Semrush, Ahrefs, DataForSEO and Serpstat, with no subscription to any of them. Give a domain and get rankings and their trend, quick wins, keyword and backlink gaps against competitors, a technical crawl, page checks and AI search visibility, turned into a prioritised action plan. Run it again to see what changed. You approve the plan before it starts and pay per call through Glasser; failed calls cost $0.00.
